summary: SK Telecom filed a Form 6-K to provide an update on its clarification regarding media reports about a potential equity investment by Kohlberg Kravis Roberts in an AI data center project and a contemplated capital increase of approximately KRW 1 trillion. The filing confirms the company continues to review strategic options but states no specific determinations or decisions have been made, and expects further disclosure when matters are determined or within three months. No definitive terms, prices, or transaction structure were disclosed, making this a routine clarification rather than a special-situation event.
